mapper.sql: ID AS id, EMAIL AS email, PASSWORD AS password, USERNAME AS username, ADDRESS AS address, PHONE_NUMBER AS phoneNumber, ROLE AS role, STATUS AS status, CAST(CREATED_AT AS TIMESTAMP) AS createdAt, CAST(UPDATED_AT AS TIMESTAMP) AS updatedAt, CAST(LEAVE_DATE AS TIMESTAMP) AS leaveDate, -- ✅ 추가 PROVIDER AS provider, PROVIDER_ID AS providerId
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MP_USER WHERE LOWER(EMAIL) = LOWER(#{email})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MP_USER ( ID, EMAIL, PASSWORD, USERNAME, ADDRESS, PHONE_NUMBER, ROLE, STATUS, PROVIDER, PROVIDER_ID, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( MP_USER_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{email}, #{password}, #{username}, NVL(#{address}, ' '), NVL(#{phoneNumber}, ' '), 'USER', 'ACTIVE', 'MYPLATE', NULL, SYSTIMESTAMP )
